name: Citizenship by Marriage (registration)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires being married to a Dominican citizen and holding a valid residence and work permit.
Requires residing in Dominica for at least 3 years while remaining married to the Dominican-citizen spouse throughout that period.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 3 years' residence in Dominica while remaining married.

sources.title: Dominica Consulate (Greece) -- Commonwealth of Dominica Citizenship by Marriage summary

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Dominica's initial build. STATUS SET TO DRAFT and sourced only at tier 3: the Constitution's Section 100 (the only tier-1-adjacent text found) does not itself establish marriage-based citizenship -- it explicitly leaves room for Parliament to create further acquisition methods by ordinary statute (Section 101), and this 3-year figure is presumed to come from the Citizenship Act itself, which could not be read in this pass (PDF not machine-readable). The 3-year figure is corroborated by more than one independent tier-3/4 source (this consulate summary and separate law-firm advisory pages), which is why it is encoded here rather than omitted entirely -- but it is NOT independently confirmed against the Act's actual text, so treat it as provisional. If a Dominican citizen naturalised via dm_citizenship_by_investment as a single applicant later marries, the same tier-3 source states their spouse can apply at any time without the 3-year wait -- not modelled as a separate group here since it could not be corroborated at a stronger tier. Revisit if the Citizenship Act text becomes readable.
